description: English speech 12–22 s, with right context; native Praat reference, not WASM-derived

native.script:
Read from file: "$REPO/dist/audio/speech-english.wav"
Extract part: 12, 22.1, "rectangular", 1, "no"
To Spectrogram: 0.005, 5000, 0.005, 10, "Gaussian"
Select outer viewport: 0, 6, 0, 7.2
Paint: 0, 10, 0, 5000, 100, "yes", 70, 6, 0, "no"
Save as 300-dpi PNG file: "$REPO/tests/visual/generated/native-reference.png"
To Matrix
Save as text file: "$REPO/tests/visual/generated/matched-native-matrix.txt"
